products.createHint: A new product is a draft. After creating it, add variants and images on the edit page, then publish.
products.publishDescription: The product appears on the storefront with its active variants. A published product cannot go back to draft.
products.archiveDescription: The product disappears from the storefront. You can sell it again at any time.
products.publishNeedsVariant: Add at least one active variant before publishing.
products.variantsHint: Each variant is a color × size with its own SKU and price. The SKU cannot change after creation.
products.skuHint: Uppercase letters, digits and hyphens; suggested from the slug, color and size
products.variantExists: This product already has this color × size
products.imagesHint: All sizes of a color share its images. The first image of each color is the main image.
products.imagesNeedVariant: Add a variant first: each color with a variant gets its own image uploader.
products.imageDeleteDescription: The image is removed from the product and from storage.

categories.name: Name
categories.invalidParent: Parent creates a cycle or does not exist
categories.deleteDescription: Only a category with no subcategories and no products can be deleted. This cannot be undone.
categories.notEmpty: Cannot delete: the category still has subcategories or products. Move them to another category first.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.invalid: Invalid input; check code, value and dates

internalAccounts.title: Internal accounts
internalAccounts.emailTaken: This email is already in use
internalAccounts.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with upper and lower case letters, a number and a symbol.
internalAccounts.createHint: New accounts get the Staff role. Assign more roles on the edit page after creating.
internalAccounts.rolesHint: Changes apply immediately; the account must sign in again to get the new permissions.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Sizes shared by every product. A size used by a variant can be hidden, not deleted.
sizes.codeHint: Uppercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. M, XL, FREESIZE
sizes.codeLocked: The code cannot change after creation
sizes.isHiddenHint: A hidden size cannot be picked for new variants and is not a storefront filter

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Colors shared by every product. A color used by a variant can be hidden, not deleted.
colors.codeHint: Uppercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. BLK, WHT
colors.codeLocked: The code cannot change after creation
colors.isHiddenHint: A hidden color cannot be picked for new variants and is not a storefront filter

salePrices.title: Sale prices
salePrices.hint: A price below the regular price for a period. Each variant has at most one sale price at a time.
salePrices.noActiveVariant: Needs at least one variant on sale.
salePrices.conflict: Overlaps another sale price of the same variant.
salePrices.rejected: The sale price must be below the price and cannot start in the past.
salePrices.endTitle: End the sale price of {sku} now?
salePrices.endDescription: The effective price returns to the regular price at once.
salePrices.deleteTitle: Delete the upcoming sale price of {sku}?
salePrices.deleteDescription: It has not started, so it can be deleted.
salePrices.priceBelowSale: The price must stay above a current or upcoming sale price. Change the sale price first.

invalid.after: End must be after the start
